Lessons.Title: Weight and Capacity Measurements
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will apply your understanding of multiplicative comparison and unit conversion to solve multi-step problems about weight and capacity.
In earlier lessons, you were introduced to several units of weight and capacity (kilograms, grams, pounds, ounces, liters, and milliliters). In this lesson, you solve problems involving the units of capacity you worked with in grade 3. You use your knowledge of unit conversion and multiplicative reasoning to solve multi-step problems.
Core relationship: Mass and capacity measurement problems. Convert to milliliters or grams before multi-step addition/subtraction.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:   Number Talk: Lots of Thousands	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Milk and Mango Lassi	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  Clay for Art Class	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  More Clay	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: How many milliliters are in 2 L 300 mL?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): A 3-L bottle loses 750 mL. How much remains?
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
